summary: OCTO AS (org. no. 990 545 561) is a private limited company (AS) based in Sandefjord, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2006-11-22. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 70.200 (Bedriftsrådgivning og annen administrativ rådgivning). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 390 000 and net income was NOK 14 777. Board chair: Dag Bjørnar Slørdahl; auditor: CEDRA NORGE AS.
